scope: Independent design review; not implementation authorization, performance acceptance, or model closure.

findings.problem: Fresh child loaders isolate loader-owned statics but not JVM-wide state, JDK registries, native state or threads. The actual transitive Alloy/Jackson code, platform delegation and retained globals have not been audited; a reset acknowledgement and finite differential cases cannot establish equivalence to process exit. The proposal correctly labels this unresolved, but cannot yet support an implementation-ready isolation contract.
findings.required_fix: Complete the concrete loaded-class/global-registration and native-state audit, specify externally observable cleanup and failure criteria, and revise the design with bounded fresh-worker differential tests. If the invariant cannot be established, retain one-shot workers.

findings.problem: Sealed image transport into bubblewrap, deterministic logical BuildIdentity reconstruction, bootstrap classpath correspondence, aggregate process lineage and live-slot ownership remain unspecified or unverified. These are essential to preserve immutable loading, current-build mutation denial and safe recovery, not merely postimplementation performance details.
findings.required_fix: Freeze an executable descriptor/mount/bootstrap and manifest plan with explicit lineage/ledger transitions and failure cleanup; demonstrate feasibility in isolation under inherited limits and submit revised hashes for council review before production implementation.

findings.problem: The current HTTP p95 fails the target and measured worker and persistence components identify opportunities, but fresh-loader, image, retirement and full fenced-session costs are not established. The selected complexity may not deliver the required improvement.
findings.required_fix: Profile the precise current stages and the candidate overhead without changing workload or omitting retirement; retain failures. Independently evaluate a combined scoped read plus owned-ID bridge as a separately reviewed lower-risk option that preserves fresh-process isolation.

formal_and_commercial: The 22 candidate propositions are abstract and unregistered; fresh-worker observational equivalence is an explicit premise. Existing 287 claims, a model build or finite differential evidence alone do not prove runtime correspondence or authorize deployment. Performance gains would not close separate accessibility, rights, security, support or commercialization obligations.
alternative: First investigate a single scoped persistence bridge operation that returns the exact authorized base and complete owned-ID inventory in one transaction while preserving current fresh worker, SQL parser path, history, failure behavior and per-request authorization. Give it its own frozen contract and measure end-to-end before selecting it; do not infer a pass from component sums.
